title: PosScheduleOverride

merchant_id.description: The Grubhub or third-party provided external ID for the merchant.

name.description: Type of schedule. If not specified, defaults to "DELIVERY"

type.description: Type of schedule override. "UNAVAILABLE" is a duration when the merchant should be closed, when normally they would be open. "AVAILABLE" is a duration when the merchant should be open, when normally they would be closed.

local_start_time.description: The time in the merchant's timezone when the override duration starts.

local_end_time.description: The time in the merchant's timezone when the override duration ends.

start_time_utc.description: The UTC time when the override duration starts.

end_time_utc.description: The UTC time when the override duration ends.

description: Schedule Override for a merchant. Schedule overrides are ad hoc modifications to a merchant's normal hours of operation on Grubhub.

updated_by.description: The last credential to update the schedule

created_date.description: The creation date of the schedule

updated_date.description: The last update date of the schedule

legacy_id.description: The legacy ID of the schedule in MySQL

source.description: The source of the creation or update of the schedule override

ScheduleOverrideMetadata.description: The metadata associated to a specific schedule override
